title: Each draft links to the page its contact was found on, so the Owner can look before sending
description: The Owner asked to see where an address came from before he sends to it. A hunt already records the public page each contact was found on, but the drafts list dropped it. Now fwd lists it with every draft: the page the hunt recorded, or for a draft without one its contact page, then its event page. Drafts already written get it the same way with no rewrite. Any flow's own draft that names a source page keeps it. The draft viewer shows Found on and the site's name as a link that opens the page in a new tab; a draft with no page says so. Only a web address is ever shown.
acceptance: fwd lists source_url with each draft: the recorded page first, then the contact page, then the event page
A draft with no page, or with an address that is not http or https, lists none
The draft viewer shows a link to the page that opens in a new tab and sends no request
A draft with no page shows no link and says none is on record
